text:
maria: kicking off canary for api-routing v1.2.0 — plan is 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m pauses and health guards. tagging @chen for SLO gates

alex: noted. do we require manual approval at 25%?

maria: yes. manual approval after 25% stage. auto-rollback if error-rate > 1.5x baseline or p95 latency degrades > 30% for 5m.

chen: can we make the latency guard based on service-specific p95 instead of global? otherwise noisy.

maria: good call. will scope to api-routing service. also added a small safety net: if throughput drops > 20% for 2 minutes, rollback.

alex: what about change windows? this is during our maintenance window at 02:00 UTC, but product wants an earlier try. we should require an approvals tag if outside window.

taylor: product prefers earlier canary at 18:00 UTC to catch regional traffic patterns. we can do it but want stricter guards + a mandatory pm + infra approval.

maria: proposed update to CI: deploy-bot should block stage progression outside change window until both pm and infra approve. sample rollout YAML below:

```yaml
rollout: canary
stages:
  - pct: 5
    pause: 10m
  - pct: 25
    pause: 10m
    require_manual_approval: true
  - pct: 100
guards:
  - type: error_rate
    service: api-routing
    threshold_multiplier: 1.5
    lookback: 5m
  - type: latency_p95
    service: api-routing
    threshold_increase_pct: 30
    lookback: 5m
  - type: throughput_drop
    service: api-routing
    threshold_decrease_pct: 20
    lookback: 2m
change_windows:
  - start: 02:00
    end: 04:00
    timezone: UTC
approval_policy:
  outside_window: ["pm", "infra"]
```

maria: deploy-bot, please enforce the approval_policy and emit telemetry hooks to the rollout dashboard.

deploy-bot: @maria acknowledged. Creating rollout job: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/1752923456 (status: queued) :gear:

chen: make sure the rollout dashboard has these panels prewired: traffic split, error rate by canary/global, p95 latency overlay, request rate, and traced spans sample. we need 1-min resolution during rollout.

alex: agree. also add a tiny experiment flag so we can A/B metrics later. traffic split labels should include variant id and bucket id for correlation.

maria: added experiment flag to config. example traffic header: X-RW-ROLLOUT: variant=canary-v1.2.0;bucket=42

taylor: approvals: i'll be the pm approver. @infra please confirm.

sre-oncall: i'll watch the dashboard during the rollout. if anything looks off i'll hit rollback and notify @maria and @taylor.

deploy-bot: rollout job started. stage: 5% -> deploying. monitors: [error_rate, latency_p95, throughput]. hooks: telemetry.connect, trace.sample(1%). Logs: https://logs.redwood/rollouts/1752923456

alex: quick question about console UX: can we show the guard thresholds inline on the canary slider? so approvers know thresholds without digging into YAML.

maria: yes, that's on my todo for the rollouts UX. show threshold badges next to percent steps and a one-click approve/abort in the modal.

chen: one more: add a cooldown window for repeated rollbacks to avoid flip-flop. e.g., if a rollback happened twice in last 24h, block new canaries for that service until manual review.

maria: implemented as cooldown policy in CI. will also add a warning banner in the console.

deploy-bot: stage completed: 5% stable for 12m. advancing to 25% is blocked pending manual approval (outside change window: false). Waiting for approvals from: [taylor, infra].

taylor: approving now. :thumbsup:

alex: infra?

chen: infra gives approval. approved.

deploy-bot: approvals received. advancing to 25% (pause 10m). telemetry hooks active. :rocket:

sre-oncall: watching p95. all green so far.

maria: thanks everyone. reminder: add a short post-rollout note to the incident channel even if everything is OK, so product has visibility.

alex: will do a 1-line summary after full rollout.

deploy-bot: final stage reached: 100% traffic. Rollout complete. metrics: error_rate delta 0.97x baseline, p95 delta +8%, throughput -1%. No auto-rollbacks triggered. Job archived: https://ci.redwood/rollouts/1752923456/job/complete

maria: excellent. follow-up items: 1) UX ticket to surface guard thresholds 2) dashboard template for canary rollouts 3) add cooldown policy docs. I'll open PRs for 1 and 2.

taylor: thanks team! :tada:
